decisive_items: small to medium-sized, atypical lymphocytes with focal areas of epidermotropism
clonal amplification product for the γ-chain of the T-cell receptor
Positive for CD2, CD3, CD4, and CD45RO
response.rationale: Mycosis fungoides is the specific cutaneous T-cell lymphoma supported by chronic scaly patches, CD4+ atypical epidermotropic lymphocytes, and clonal TCR rearrangement. Sézary syndrome is excluded by the absence of atypical cells in peripheral blood, and the broader CTCL label is less specific.

rejected.why: Sézary syndrome requires erythroderma and circulating Sézary cells; peripheral blood showed no atypical cells and erythroderma is not described.
